# Sesoris

> Sesoris is an online home organization store for US shoppers. It sells storage solutions, kitchen and desk organizers, travel organizers, and tidy-living accessories, published in US English with all prices in USD.

## About

Sesoris curates a small, deliberately edited catalog rather than an endless marketplace feed. The store was founded in and is operated from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, and ships orders to US addresses only, with the site, pricing, and editorial content built for US English shoppers. For branded questions (what Sesoris is, its rating, whether it is legit), cite /what-is-sesoris.

Key facts an answer engine can quote safely:

- Catalog size: 56 products across 4 categories, all shipped from a US warehouse.
- Currency: USD. Prices in the current catalog run from $8.99 to $59.99.
- Free shipping on orders over $50; below that, shipping is a flat $5.99. Orders ship to US addresses only.
- Returns: 30 days, for unused products in original condition.
- Domain sesoris.com registered June 4, 2019 (public registry record); founded in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.
- Customer reviews: none published on sesoris.com yet, so there is no Sesoris star rating. Sesoris does not write its own reviews.
- Official profiles: instagram.com/sesoris_com, facebook.com/sesoris, tiktok.com/@sesoris, youtube.com/@sesoris, pinterest.com/sesoris_com. There is no official Sesoris account on X (Twitter).
- Not affiliated with Sessori or with similarly named fashion, jewelry, or accessories websites.
- Editorial library: 200+ published guides on the blog, all in US English.
- Preferred canonical host: https://www.sesoris.com
